proof.basis: reviewed static ARM control-flow/ABI reasoning; byte checks do not automatically prove C/original equivalence

caller.scope: cgminer selected inline address stage only; no hwscan startup caller established

domain: Returning synchronous ARM-conforming callees, stable callback/context/identity associations, live reached objects and borrowed temporaries
Device/chip fields may change during callbacks; failure logs must observe the specified late reads
One normal string initializer pass and unchanged decoded strings; ordinary readable opaque globals
Caller facts assume live retained owner/board view, valid per-iteration chip array, no pointer/offset wrap, and finite loop progress

logs.address: late full chip word at +4, independently reloaded after send
logs.address_format: chain#%d - failed to assign chip address to 0x%02x
logs.inactive_format: chain#%d - failed to inactivate the chain
logs.index: late full device word at +0x18 plus one modulo 2^32

nonclaims: No original execution, instruction interpreter, emulator, hardware or model/OOM probes
No automatic C equivalence, full startup implementation, callable numeric method table or hwscan caller proof
No fault/MMIO/unaligned-access traces, raw stack equivalence, races, nonlocal returns, physical ACK or queue/power barrier
Runtime prefix is historical evidence; later gated append outside it is allowed, and current whole-file admission remains separate shared/L09/L12/A13 exact gates
